・As a key milestone of our project, we will launch Web game at least beta version which can play everyone. Probably, our game volume itself is not so large and qualities is not so high. However, our project team is really close to Japan Cardano Community. We can take users feedback into our gamge improvement. In addition to this, this is quite important that the new educated engineer by our project still need practice, therefore even though their fees are not so high the practice itself is quite important to get next project. ・Explanation for (B) 
・When the large ADA holder want to buy items through real product linked NFT, they want to protect their individual information. The NFT key locker is one solution to achieve this like the shopping at real store.
